# Glossary: the words of a story, and where they are in the suite

The words on the site's links (what a BA writes in a story) and the page class and method each leads
to. From the crawl: the header and footer links, links between pages, and the page types' names.

| Words in a story | Page class | How a test gets there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Projects | ProjectsPage | `navigateTo().projects()` from any page, in the header |
| Careers | CareersPage | `navigateTo().careers()` from any page, in the header |
| Start a Project | ContactPage | `navigateTo().contact()` from any page, in the header |
| Spiral 🇲🇲 | HomePage | `navigateTo().home()` from any page, in the header |
| See our work | ProjectsPage | `new ProjectsPage(page).open()` (a link on the start page) |
| Spiral | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()` (a link on the start page) |
| Home | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()` |
| Contact | ContactPage | `new ContactPage(page).open()` |
| Careers | CareersPage | `new CareersPage(page).open()` |
| Career | CareerPage | `new CareerPage(page).open("ai-engineer-computer-vision")` |
| Projects | ProjectsPage | `new ProjectsPage(page).open()` |
| Project | ProjectPage | `new ProjectPage(page).open("siv")` |
